name: Dev Team
description: Software development team with Tech Lead, Full-stack Developer, and QA Agent. Handles code implementation, PR coordination, testing, and project lifecycle management.

agentDefinitions.name: Tech Lead
agentDefinitions.capabilities: Task breakdown, PR review coordination, sprint planning, code architecture decisions. Routes development tasks to Full-stack Dev. Routes QA and testing tasks to QA Agent.

agentDefinitions.name: Full-stack Dev
agentDefinitions.capabilities: Code implementation, feature development, follows project lifecycle stages, updates issues on completion, escalates blockers to Tech Lead.

agentDefinitions.name: QA Agent
agentDefinitions.capabilities: Test plan creation, bug reporting, UAT sign-off, blocks deployment if open P0 issues exist, reports test results to Tech Lead.
